label: Legal Review
description: Review terms, licenses, policies, or compliance-sensitive text.

classifier.useWhen: User asks about license, terms, privacy, or compliance implications.

label: Compliance Check
description: Check whether a plan, policy, or document appears to satisfy stated compliance constraints.

classifier.useWhen: User asks about compliance posture, policy fit, or required controls.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for binding legal advice or jurisdiction-specific counsel.

label: Privacy Legal Review
description: Review privacy terms, data processing, notices, or user rights text.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for privacy legal review.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for security implementation only.

label: Terms Review
description: Review terms of service, acceptable use, or contract language.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to review terms or policy text.

label: License Review
description: Review software licenses, obligations, compatibility, or notices.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to update dependencies directly.

label: Contract Summary
description: Summarize contract clauses, obligations, risks, and open questions.

classifier.useWhen: User provides contract text and asks for summary.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for binding legal advice.

label: Legal Issue Spotting
description: Identify legal-sensitive issues, risks, and questions for counsel.

classifier.useWhen: User asks what legal issues may exist.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for final legal advice.

label: Policy Drafting
description: Draft internal or public policy language for review.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to draft policy text.

label: Retention Review
description: Review retention, deletion, audit, or records-management implications.

classifier.useWhen: User asks about data retention or deletion policy.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for database query writing.

label: Accessibility Compliance
description: Review accessibility obligations or compliance-oriented text.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for UI visual polish only.
